{{Quote|This is outrageous! I'm not a spy, I'm a journalist for Iziz Comm.|The journalist protests his detainment|<ref name="TSL" />}}
This '''journalist''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] working for the [[Iziz Comm]] news outlet in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. During the [[Onderon Civil War]] the man was detained by [[Onderon separatists|separatist]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] accusing him of spying and spreading propaganda. A passer-by, [[Meetra Surik]], intervened and persuaded the soldiers to free him given that they had no proof of criminal activity. The [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] thanked Surik and left Iziz.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], this [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] participated in the [[Mandalorian Wars]], serving in the [[Onderonian resistance|resistance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. He worked for the [[Iziz Comm]] news outlet and during the [[Onderon Civil War]] he reported on [[Onderon separatists|separatist]] leader [[Vaklu]] withholding information about the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], accused of treachery by the separatists. While in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the journalist was apprehended by a pair of separatist [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who accused him of being a spy and spreading propaganda.<ref name="TSL" />
{{GameLS|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
Before the soldiers could take the man away for an [[interrogation]] [[Meetra Surik]], an exiled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] passing by, queried the journalist's captors about whether they had a warrant or any proof of their claims. Despite their insistence that they were acting accordingly, Surik convinced the soldiers that the man was innocent and they freed him. The journalist thanked Surik and escaped the city, fearing repercussions. Later, city news reports advised that authorities believed the man was indeed a Republic spy and that he was suspected of the destruction of the [[South Quarter Mining Refinery]].<ref name="TSL" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'm sure this self-righteous mudlicker could meet with an accident along the way.|A dark-side dialogue option the player can choose|<ref name="TSL" />}}
This journalist first appears in the [[2005]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] as a background character the player encounters upon entering the Merchant Quarter area. If the player chooses to intervene in the incident they can use persuasion, both the character skill and Force varieties, to allow the journalist to go free and earn [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points. As a non-canon [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] alternative, the player can suggest that the soldiers pretend the journalist has made an escape attempt or, for a higher dark side bonus, vehemently recommend an "accident" befall the journalist.
